subject: Post-demo: Hosted evaluation & sandbox access (CartWave)
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mike Lawson <mike.lawson@cartwave.com>
Cc: Anna Ops <anna.ops@cartwave.com>
Date: 2028-06-15T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: Hosted evaluation & sandbox access (CartWave)

Hi Mike / Anna —

Thanks again for the demo time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get CartWave started on a Hosted API evaluation: 

What we covered
- Scope: add AI-powered product recommendations and a shopping-assist chat widget for US customers first.
- Typical payloads: short context (user cart + 2–3 product descriptions) and conversational fallback.
- Success criteria you mentioned: latency below 250ms P50, cost target ~ $0.0006/token for dev/pilot, and predictable throughput during campaigns.

Questions we still need from you
1) Expected peak RPS (30-minute burst) and steady-state RPS and average prompt length (tokens).
2) Any regulated data or PII that requires VPC or private deployment? You said internal orders/stats are fine in-hosted but wanted to confirm.
3) Ops contacts for SOC2 / security questionnaire (if you have a specific procurement contact).

Recommended quickstart plan (Hosted API)
- Day 0: Provide sandbox API key + endpoint (we’ll map one sandbox endpoint per environment: dev/staging).
- Week 1: Run traffic slice (recommended 1k–5k tokens/day) to validate latency and prefix caching benefits.
- Week 2: Load test at your expected peak RPS with our staging endpoint; we’ll advise ratecap adjustments.

Preliminary rate guidance (for sandbox)
- Default slice: 5 RPS / 8 concurrent tokens for initial pilot
- Burst-friendly plan: up to 25 RPS during scheduled campaigns with queueing/backpressure recommended

Attachments: I’m attaching sandbox-access-instructions.pdf and a lightweight mutual action plan template to make scheduling and ownership explicit.

Next steps
- Mike: confirm peak/steady RPS and token estimates, and whether any data needs to be routed to a VPC.
- Anna: please share the procurement/security contact for the SOC2 packet.
- Ben/Soojin (cc): can you review the suggested ratebands and confirm the sandbox endpoint mapping?

Can we aim for a quick follow-up on Thursday 6/18 at 10am PT to go over the sandbox access and run a short smoke test? If that works I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0192

--
Attachment: sandbox-access-instructions.pdf (PDF, 128KB)
Attachment: mutual-action-plan-CartWave.xlsx (XLSX, 24KB)

From: Mike Lawson <mike.lawson@cartwave.com>

Cc: Anna Ops <anna.ops@cartwave.com>
Date: 2028-06-15T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Hosted evaluation & sandbox access (CartWave)

Thanks Evelyn — good summary. A few quick answers: 

- Peak/steady RPS: peak ~20 RPS for flash promotions (5–10 minute bursts), steady ~3–4 RPS.
- Token estimates: average prompt ~160 tokens, typical response ~220 tokens.
- Data residency: US-only for now. We will not send full payment card data; order metadata and product SKUs are fine.
- Security/procurement contact: Anna (cc) will own the SOC2 packet and vendor questionnaire.

We’re happy to start Hosted to move faster — if we need higher isolation later we can evaluate Dedicated or Private. For the pilot, please provision sandbox keys for dev and staging.

Thursday 6/18 10am PT works — Anna and I will be there.

—Mike
Mike Lawson
Head of Product | CartWave
E: mike.lawson@cartwave.com | O: +1 (650) 555-0100

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-16T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Hosted evaluation & sandbox access (CartWave)

Evelyn — looping in a couple of technical specifics for the sandbox plan and rate guidance.

Notes / recommendations:
- Sandbox endpoints: we’ll create two isolated sandbox endpoints: 
  * dev: /v1/engines/cartwave-dev-infer (lower concurrency, used for integration)
  * staging: /v1/engines/cartwave-stage-infer (higher concurrency, perf tests)
- Rate caps and tokens: initially set dev to 5 RPS / staging 15 RPS. For the smoke test on 6/18 we can temporarily allow 25 RPS for a 10-minute window — please confirm exact test window.
- Prefix/KV caching: given repeated product descriptions, enabling prefix caching should reduce token spend by ~18–25% in your pattern; we’ll enable by default for the pilot endpoints.
- Monitoring hooks: add the sandbox keys to our Console so CartWave can see token-level cost and p50/p95 latency. I’ll share a short runbook for tracing.

Security/Procurement ask:
- SOC2: we’ll provide our SOC2 Type II report and an audit checklist link. If Anna can share any custom controls, we’ll map them back.

Attachments:
- sandbox-access-instructions.pdf (step-by-step with curl examples)
- mutual-action-plan-CartWave.xlsx (milestones + owner columns)

I’ll publish the two sandbox endpoints once Evelyn confirms the names and Mike confirms the tentative smoke-test window for Thursday.

—Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Perfect — thanks for the quick replies. Confirming next steps: 

1) Ben will provision two sandbox endpoints (dev + staging) and upload the runbook and SOC2 packet to the shared Drive link.
2) We’ll schedule a 30-min smoke test on Thursday 6/18 at 10:00am PT. For the smoke test please plan for a 10-minute burst at 25 RPS; Ben will temporarily raise the staging cap.
3) Anna — please send the security questionnaire to security@redwoodinference.com; we’ll fill in the SOC2 evidence and map any custom controls.
4) I’ll create the HubSpot deal (CART-5421) and attach the mutual action plan — you’ll get an update after the smoke test.

Calendar invite sent. Looking forward to the test — we’ll keep the scope narrow and confirm next steps post-smoke (if perf looks good we’ll expand token budget and add the chat widget flows).

Best,
